description: This Java class, ConciergeEnforcerClusterRouterFactory, is responsible for creating and configuring an Akka cluster router actor specifically for the EnforcerActor within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides factory method for setting up a ClusterRouterGroup with consistent hashing to distribute messages based on a routing key.

classes.name: ConciergeEnforcerClusterRouterFactory
classes.description: A final utility class providing a factory method to create a configured Akka ClusterRouterGroup actor for the EnforcerActor, facilitating message routing within an Akka cluster with consistent hashing based distribution.

methods.name: createConciergeEnforcerClusterRouter
methods.description: Creates and returns an ActorRef for a ClusterRouterGroup configured with consistent hashing to route messages to EnforcerActor instances across the cluster, given an ActorContext and number of routees.
